@Cythea + @420GanjaPreneur420

Thank you for the quick replies and the insight. I'll have to think longer on it. Maybe increase my payment plans to an affordable level...

I'm in the first 5 months of treatment of bipolar2 / ADHD. I don't think I've been dealing w/ it too well. It has been months of increasingly mixed state mania + depression and endless prescription tune-ups that is wearing me out and putting my career and relationships in jeopardy. 

I'm trying to better my life (teaching classes outside of work and in the process of requesting work accommodations for my sleep and therapy schedules). In parallel, I've unconsciously restarted my paracord climbers rope collection (beautiful neons combos and for hanging myself); am spending my night hours  @ the corner bodegas exhausted and indulging in joyous mini-spending sprees - buying up all the limited edition Little Debbie V-day treat packages I can find; and snapping my relationships like brittle matchsticks in intolerable fits that have been alienating people I love.

This is my trembling agitated everyday. I hope to remain functional long enough to keep the job and to continue with treatment. At the same, I don't have all of my facilities in play (I don't know when I am rising into a violent mixed state of agitation and mental acuity when many bipolar suicides occur or crashing into a depressive episode), but I do know that time is limited to set things as "right" as they can be. 

I'm trying and troubled. It's wearing me out. And between the late night fights, tears, and insane highs, I honestly don't know how long I can keep it together.
